title: OS-Harm: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety of Computer Use Agents

layout.note: Four equal pale blue square cards in one row joined by three thick black arrows; each card has a large bold title on top, a robot, logo row or sample tile in the middle and short text below.

lesson: Give each stage of an evaluation pipeline one equal tinted card with a big title, one recognisable icon and a few short lines; reuse the same robot character for agent and judge (adding a robe and gavel) so roles read at a glance, and end the chain with the judge's questions as the output.
